objective: measure requested full-state counterfactual action response without any Jacobian or central-secant approximation
interpretation: diagnostic stochastic mean first-action response only; no physical safety or statistical authorization without hard controller output proof
action_chart: PushT absolute_xy physical first action; no silent clipping
per_state_target_queries: 2 requests x (3 decision + 3 audit) seed pairs x 4 policy first actions = 48
exact_state_contract: restore original PushT snapshot before each shifted-block observation; agent and target baseline remain frozen; no environment.step during probe
trusted_bounds_consequence: REJECT_UNTRUSTED_BOUND / zero certified policy transfers. A Gym action_space declaration is NOT proof policy outputs or simulator actions are clipped.

sources.pusht_dependency: gym-pusht>=0.1.5 as in pinned LeRobot pyproject; resolved installed wheel/version must be recorded; absent exact immutable runtime means provenance limitation

stop_rule: No missing state or A/B pair may be excluded or replaced. Experiment incomplete if fewer than 5 valid state outputs. No post-result modification of thresholds or hidden state substitutions.
comparison_limitations: Direct target observations are counterfactual-oracle access; do not compare query budget or performance to methods denied such oracle access. Six stochastic draws do not establish ground truth. This is not closed-loop rollout success.
